body: Compaction end = SessionStart(source=compact) as the spec says, not the documented PostCompact hook (it exists: trigger + compact_summary). Alternative PostCompact would need one more hook group and carries the summary text we must not ship.

Done line waits up to COMPACT_NUMBERS_WAIT=10s for the first StatusLine whose context differs from the last one before the end (before refreshed at SessionStart compact), else goes without percentages. Alternative: send at once with before only (no after known then).
Status timer in whole minutes (next_deadline wakes at each minute), so a compaction costs about one edit per minute. Alternative: seconds timer, an edit every status_every (5s).

PreCompact hook group gets timeout 5 s and the short 300/600 ms POST budget; hook never prints or exits non-zero, so it can never block compaction. Alternative: default timeout (600 s) like the other lifecycle hooks.

Cancelled/failed compaction: UserPromptSubmit, ToolStart hook, Stop or a written Esc of the session marks the running record settled (status stops showing Compacting at once); SessionStart(compact) is still taken for COMPACT_GRACE=30s after that, then the record is forgotten with no line. Alternative rejected: drop the record on activity (reviewer simplest variant) - ToolStart/Stop are async POSTs that can race SessionStart(compact) and the done line would be lost.

Stream items (transcript lines) do not settle a compaction, only hooks and a written Esc. Alternative: tool calls from the stream - they lag the session by any time and can describe calls from before the PreCompact.
